messages.subject: Problems with russian letter 'я' in code
parts:
I have the simple code:
server.R
32          list(
33            checkboxInput(inputId = 'header', label = 'Первая строка - заголовок', value = TRUE),

When i run code i have error:
/server.R:33:55: неожиданный INCOMPLETE_STRING    

#translation for 'неожиданный' is unexpected

if i run this (another lines of code are the same):
server.R
32          list(
33            checkboxInput(inputId = 'header', label = 'Перва  строка - заголовок', value = TRUE),

Anything is allright.

Is this a known problem ? What can i do? I'm tired of constantly look for synonyms of the words, which meets this letter. :)

messages.subject: Re: Problems with russian letter 'я' in code
